purpose: interactive user-command work continuity, direct next-step execution, no predeclared stop procedures
restrictions: No normal exit while CI is nonterminal and tools remain available
No X product publish without /推推
No new recurring schedule or workflow_run coding agent
No DC access (including list_devices or ping) without explicit current device/operation authorization and external approval
Same-issue default GitHub localX merge requires exact CI GREEN, mergeability, verified base change impact and expected HEAD
Windows localX sync and manual UAT remain independently pending unless verified
No force/reset and no product X publish without user /推推
PR merge, Issue close/readback or next_issue_checked alone MUST NOT finish /派工: eligible next issue must be started and CONTINUE_NEXT_ISSUE; only verified NO_ELIGIBLE_ISSUE permits normal queue exit
INTERACTIVE_COMMAND_NO_STOP_HARD_GATE_V1: Never predeclare a stopping procedure; a blocked individual tool call is not project completion; directly perform the next authorized action

EXPLICIT_DC_LOCALX.on_success: LOCALX_SYNCED only after safe merge and both SHA readback

route_selection_order: Use EXPLICIT_DC_LOCALX only when the user explicitly requests scoped DC and external platform approves
Otherwise after exact CI success and same-scope BUG/dispatch authorization: GITHUB_LOCALX_FIRST without contacting DC
On CI RED, PR conflict, permissions denial or unknown base drift: BLOCKED_WITH_EVIDENCE, not force or DC workaround

route_readback_invariants.GITHUB_LOCALX_FIRST: GITHUB_LOCALX_MERGED + WINDOWS_LOCALX_SYNC_PENDING; workstation SHA and UAT unverified
route_readback_invariants.EXPLICIT_DC_LOCALX: LOCALX_SYNCED only after successful local safe merge, nonforce remote sync and both SHA readback

interactive_command_hard_gate.alternative_actions: continue other authorized operations without bypassing actual access denials
interactive_command_hard_gate.combined_command_owner: one Issue/PR/branch; feature defines acceptance, debug diagnoses, dispatch delivers, takeover requires explicit authority
